Dental implants in Austin, TX

Updated November 1, 2026 · by Dr. Jane Smith, DDS

Example Dental is a dental practice in downtown Austin, Texas, focused on dental implants and general dentistry for adults. Our team has placed more than 1,200 implants since 2014, and every treatment plan starts with a 3D scan and a written quote, so patients know the full cost before any procedure begins.

How much does a dental implant cost in Austin?

A single dental implant with crown costs between $3,000 and $5,000 at Example Dental in 2026, depending on bone grafting and the type of crown. The quote after the first consultation lists every item, and we offer payment plans of up to 12 months. These numbers are illustrative for this example.

How long does the implant process take?

Most patients finish in three to six months. The implant is placed in a single visit of about an hour, it bonds with the bone over eight to twelve weeks, and then we attach the permanent crown. Patients who need a bone graft may need two or three more months of healing before the implant goes in.

Our services

Besides implants, we offer cleanings, fillings, crowns, root canals and teeth whitening. Visit the frequently asked questions page or contact us to book a consultation.
